title: hone protocol 1: plugin input and output
description: The JSON that the host and a plugin exchange (concept Section 9, "Contract"). Input and output are UTF-8 JSON without `null`. `CheckInput` is the input of `check`, `CheckOutput` its output, and `DescribeOutput` the output of `describe`.

config.description: The configuration the gate runs against: the ticket's snapshot.

ticket.description: The data of the ticket record.

step.description: The name of the step whose gate runs.

params.description: The `params` of the gate entry, `{}` when it has none. For a plugin named by `evaluate`, the `params` of the `exec` gate.

artifacts.description: Every artifact and ticket record of the checked directory whose file passes the YAML profile.

changed_paths.description: The paths the change touches, relative to the project root. Absent when the caller supplied none.

tool_output.description: Only for a plugin named by `evaluate`: the result of the command.

path.description: The file, relative to the project root.

status.description: The effective status (concept Section 6). Absent when the artifact has no declared status, as with lifecycle `living`.

hash.description: The content hash (spec/artifacts.md). Present exactly when the artifact's kind has lifecycle `decided`; a living artifact and a ticket record have none.

data.description: The data model of the file: the front matter or the YAML document.

body.description: The Markdown text after the front matter, `""` for a YAML file.

exit.description: The exit code of the command.

stdout.description: Standard output, up to 1 MiB from the start, bytes that are not UTF-8 replaced.

stderr.description: Standard error, cut and replaced like `stdout`.

findings.description: The gate fails exactly when a finding has level `error`.

path.description: The file, relative to the project root, if the finding concerns one.

pointer.description: A JSON Pointer into the data model of the file, if the finding concerns a value.

capabilities.description: The capabilities the plugin asks for. The tool grants them, or fewer.
